item.title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
item.description: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course.

item.title: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
item.description: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
item.description: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

item.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
item.description: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

item.title: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
item.description: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

item.title: Websites pretending to be local news are boosting Democratic candidates
item.description: The websites of unknown origin are targeting key U.S. House races. They are getting picked up by ChatGPT's responses but Google's products avoid promoting them.
